current_answer: Choose by task, platform, and the instructions actually loaded. For a new visual target, Frontend App Builder is a conditional concept-and-render route; for a known screen and expected state, Frontend Testing & Debugging is a conditional QA route. For an existing web-app screen, first supply the route, tokens, components, visual reference, and required states. OpenDesign’s frontend-skill is a pointer to a removed OpenAI bundle, while its separate frontend-design file contains an adapted Anthropic workflow; do not treat them as the same skill. No listed skill has a pool-run comparison against a careful no-skill brief.
